title: Poland holds emergency meeting over possible attack on PM Tusk, defence minister
summary_full: Polish security services convened an emergency meeting following a reported threat against Prime Minister Donald Tusk and Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz. Authorities have been on high alert due to recent violent incidents at schools in Poland. These incidents led to arrests and concerns about online glorification of violence among youth. Tusk emphasized the spontaneous nature of these acts, suggesting no organized group is involved.
